# ConventionalAndSpikingDualMode

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A single macro architecture supporting both conventional artificial neural network (ANN) and spiking neural network (SNN) inference modes. Allows unified hardware for diverse neural models, reducing design overhead and facilitating hybrid ANN-SNN edge systems.
